profile_nudge.subject: Thank you for joining Eventtz | Eventtz
profile_nudge.html:
Thank you for joining Eventtz

Eventtz is where clients find you, and where you keep bookings, messages and payments in one calm place.

Hi Ama's Kitchen,

Thank you for joining Eventtz. We are happy to have you on board.

You have started your vendor profile but have not submitted it yet. When you have a quiet moment, finishing your application helps clients discover you with confidence.

Once you are live on Eventtz, you can: • Show clients your services and prices upfront • Receive booking requests with the date, venue and details in one place • Message clients and agree quotes without switching apps • Get paid securely through Stripe when a booking is confirmed

Add your photos, services and packages, then submit when you are ready. Our team will review your application.

Questions? Reply to this email or write us at hello@eventtz.com.

Complete your profile
